## R Markdown
Load the packages

```{r}
library(move2)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(lubridate)
library(trip)

```
Convert the walrus dataset to a move2 object

```{r}
walrus_stdf <- as(trip::walrus818[1:160, ], "SpatialPointsDataFrame") # just one track
walrus_sf <- st_as_sf(walrus_stdf)
walrus_move <- move2::mt_as_move2(walrus_sf, time_column = "DataDT", track_id_column = "Deployment")
```


```{r}
walrus_test <- trip::speedfilter(trip::walrus818[1:160, ], max.speed = 1000)

```


```{r}
this_track <- walrus_move |> filter (Deployment=="353")

```
